summary.tldr: Lets Gore Mutual Insurance Company apply to continue under Quebec law and, if it does, removes it from the federal Insurance Companies Act.
what_it_does: Authorizes Gore Mutual Insurance Company to apply to be continued as a body corporate under the laws of Quebec, as if it had been incorporated there.
Ends the company’s coverage under the Insurance Companies Act on the day it is continued under Quebec law.
Repeals three federal Acts about Gore District Mutual Fire Insurance Company when the continuation takes effect.
